June 7, 2025 - Has to be taken very early, at level 1 if possible (has Point-Blank Shot as a prerequisite). Technically, you don't get the penalty as long as you attack ranged enemies (both archers and casters) only. But in real · life game you always need to attack melee combatants sooner or later, so it makes no sense to ignore this feat. The only exception can be a solo ranged character, but since Precise Shot is a prerequisite for Clustered Shots (which can not be taken as a Ranger/Slayer Combat Style feat ignoring prerequisites), you need it anyway.

You are skilled at timing and aiming ranged attacks. Prerequisite: Point Blank Shot Benefit: You can shoot or throw ranged weapons at an opponent engaged in melee without suffering the standard penalty (see Shooting or Throwing into a Melee).
